# Visual Production

This plugin groups related workflows under one installation. Open the matching
contract before acting; do not answer from this index alone.

- [Frontend Slides](../../references/modules/frontend-slides.md)
  Build responsive page-by-page HTML reports or fixed-stage 1920x1080 presentations with deliberate typography and rendered QA. Use for reading-first reports, new decks, PowerPoint conversion, and HTML deck refinement.
- [Remotion Production](../../references/modules/remotion-production.md)
  Build deterministic programmatic video and motion graphics with Remotion as the single time authority, clear visual-engine ownership, audio and captions, frame QA, and reliable delivery. Use for rendered time-based artifacts.

Load only the supporting references the task needs. The plugin is self-contained;
do not look for a shared AzSkills entry or for other plugins in the catalog.
